summary: Gathers six component values from three vertex-source pointers referenced by the input array a2 into the output buffer a1. Reads source 0 (deref of *(a2)) at offsets 0 and 8, source 1 (deref of *(a2+4)) at offsets 8 and 16, and source 2 (deref of *(a2+8)) at offset 16 and 0, writing them to a1[0..5]. Returns the source-2 pointer.

local_names.a2: input array of three vertex-source pointers
local_names.result: pointer to the third vertex source (return value)

operations.description: Write a1[0] from the first value of the first vertex source: dereference *(a2) and copy its first dword.
Write a1[1] from the value at offset +8 of the first vertex source (*(*(_DWORD*)a2 + 8)).
Write a1[2] from the value at offset +8 of the second vertex source (*(*(_DWORD*)(a2+4) + 8)).
Write a1[3] from the value at offset +16 of the second vertex source (*(*(_DWORD*)(a2+4) + 16)).
Write a1[4] from the value at offset +16 of the third vertex source (*(*(_DWORD*)(a2+8) + 16)).
Write a1[5] from the first value of the third vertex source: dereference the pointer stored at a2+8 and copy its first dword.
Return the pointer to the third vertex source, which is the pointer value stored at a2+8.

unresolved: The layout of the input array a2 (three vertex-source pointers) and the meaning of the component offsets +8 and +16 within each source are not evidenced.
The output values are treated as raw dwords; whether they are vertex coordinates, indices, or other components is not evidenced.
The function is a straight-line gather with no guards; whether a2 can alias a1 is unknown.
